title: Study notes to flashcards
description: Reads study/notes.txt from the files folder (a sample is added for you) and has Claude turn it into question and answer cards, saved as study/flashcards.csv, which Anki and most flashcard apps can import. Replace the notes with your own under ⋯ > Files. Needs an Anthropic API key saved as a credential named "anthropic" (⋯ > Credentials).
name: Study notes to flashcards

config.system: You turn study notes into good flashcards: one fact or idea per card, no trick questions.

files.study/notes.txt:
Cell biology (sample notes: replace these with your own)

The cell is the basic unit of life. Cells come from other cells.
Mitochondria produce most of a cell's ATP through aerobic respiration.
The nucleus stores DNA; the nucleolus builds ribosomes.
Ribosomes assemble proteins from amino acids using mRNA as a template.
The Golgi apparatus modifies, sorts and ships proteins and lipids.
Plant cells have a cell wall and chloroplasts; animal cells do not.
Osmosis is the diffusion of water across a semi-permeable membrane toward higher solute concentration.
